basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast from Austin, Texas, trying to learn more about gadgets and audio devices. I recently got into headphones and audio gear, which led me to join Reddit. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work and sometimes during my lunch break. I work as a marketing assistant at a local startup and am single. I enjoy watching anime and playing online strategy games in my free time.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of technology and gadgets, primarily self-taught through online forums and YouTube videos. I enjoy keeping up with tech trends and often seek advice from more experienced users.
